---
title: "How do I estimate a value between two known measurements?"
---

## What the question asks

How do I estimate a value between two known measurements?

## Steps in RStudio

1. Sort x and y pairs by x.

2. Check the target lies inside the observed x range.

3. Use approx(x,y,xout=target) and label the estimate.

## Runnable example

```{r}
time <- c(0,5,10,15)
temperature <- c(10,16,22,21)
target <- 7.5
stopifnot(target>=min(time),target<=max(time))
print(approx(time,temperature,xout=target))
plot(time,temperature,type="b",pch=19,col="#3F78A8",
     xlab="Minutes",ylab="Temperature (C)")
points(target,approx(time,temperature,xout=target)$y,
       col="#A35E20",pch=19,cex=1.5)
```

## Interpret the result

Between 5 and 10 minutes the modeled temperature changes linearly from 16°C to 22°C. At 7.5 minutes the interpolated value is 19°C.

## Check before using real data

Interpolation assumes a straight change between known points. Do not confuse interpolation with extrapolation beyond them.
